follow_up_changes.change: ConnectionOwner.terminate/2 now runs QuicHttp3.Session.close/1 under guarded/4 on an orderly :normal stop of a ready or draining owner, then retires the cleanup lease; the :http3_retire handler no longer retires before stopping, so the close is admitted first (RFC 9114 section 5.2, H3_NO_ERROR).
follow_up_changes.dispatch_review: No dynamic dispatch added or moved: the new calls are the literal Session.close/1 inside the existing guarded/4 closure invocation, and the file holds no reviewed occurrence. Session.close/1 reaches only the already reviewed retained session.transport close and cleanup operations (H3-1).

follow_up_changes.change: HTTP.HTTP3.Pool no longer retires an exclusive owner's cleanup lease on release; it sends :http3_retire so the owner closes with H3_NO_ERROR before retiring, and still retires on owner DOWN.
follow_up_changes.dispatch_review: No dynamic dispatch added or moved: one literal Quic.Cleanup.retire/2 call path is removed; the file holds no reviewed occurrence.

follow_up_changes.change: ConnectionOwner marks itself :retiring when the watchdog, attempt tracker or creator goes DOWN, so terminate/2 skips the graceful close of the already retired connection; graceful_close/2 now also requires that no request remains, so a stop that abandons live requests through fail_all/2 keeps the previous retire/abort path instead of claiming H3_NO_ERROR.
follow_up_changes.dispatch_review: No dynamic dispatch added or moved: the change is a lifecycle field update and a map_size/1 guard; the file holds no reviewed occurrence.
